mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Reddan Soccer Park. You can also catch the International Space Station flying over tonight at 7:06 PM, appearing low in the sky as it moves from the direction of Mount Horeb toward Belleville.

October has been proclaimed Community Planning Month to recognize the hard work of our planning department. Also, please note that a section of Highway M will be closed for construction from October 6 through October 9, so plan your travels accordingly.

We have a busy couple of days ahead with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol Square or catch the music series at Paddy Mac's. Looking further ahead, the World Dairy Expo and the Farley Center Fall Festival are both happening this Saturday.
In a noteworthy call from September 21, officers identified and cited a suspect for the retail theft of Swedish Fish candy from a local store.
The flavor of the day is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough, and since the restaurant is currently open until 10:30 PM, you have plenty of time to stop by for a delicious treat.
